repo.pushedHint: Last code push to any branch
repo.updatedHint: Last change to the repository itself: description, topics, settings
repo.activityHint: Based on the last code push: within 30 days = Active, within 180 days = Quiet, otherwise Inactive. Our own rule of thumb, not a GitHub value.

token.title: GitHub personal token
token.description: Raises the search limit from 10 to 30 requests per minute. The token is sent only to api.github.com and by default lives in memory until you close this tab.
token.createLink: Create a fine-grained token on GitHub
token.invalid: GitHub rejected this token. Check that it was copied completely and has not expired.
token.failed: Could not reach GitHub to check the token. Try again.
token.quotaHelp:
GitHub has two separate quota pools.
Search (/search/*): 10 requests per minute without a token, 30 with one.
Core (everything else): 60 per hour per IP without a token, 5,000 per hour with one.
This site mostly uses the search pool, so the number shown is the search quota left this minute.
token.rememberHint: Stores the token in this browser's localStorage, where any script running on this page or any browser extension could read it. Leave off on shared computers.
token.remembered: Token configured and remembered on this device
token.leastPrivilege:
※ To limit the damage if the token ever leaks, we recommend:
・Read-only access
・Public repositories only
・A short expiry

ranking.fallback: Collecting history. Showing repositories created in the last 90 days by stars for now.
ranking.risingHint: Stars gained in the last 30 days, computed from the daily snapshot.
ranking.popularHint: Repositories in the snapshot ordered by total stars.
